review_scope: static: retail instructions and emitted candidate listing

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: 19 retail bytes, 6 instructions, 1 block, 0 edges; decoder CFG 1.000 vs candidate 1/0.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: One cdecl argument at [esp+4]; the only other value passed is the constant 0x004F1CF0, which the callee receives as its 32-bit context argument per 0x004F1D60's signature.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: Single constant 0x004F1CF0 (context object address); no arithmetic, mask or scale.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: This native performs no access of its own; the callee writes head+0x00..+0x0C. 0x004F1CF0 is referenced only by address in retail, so the candidate owns one zero-initialised byte and passes its address.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Exactly one call to 0x004F1D60 with (head, 0x004F1CF0); no other side effect and no tail jump.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: One entry, one exit at 0x004F1CE2: ret. No branch and no error path.

runtime_contract.scope: paired retail/candidate observation of the context store at head+0x0C during level-1 startup

limitations: Runtime not yet paired: candidate exits 3 at 0x00402930 before any game native runs.
The size and type of 0x004F1CF0 are unobservable; only its identity as a stored context value is established.
The 0x004F1D60 signature was corrected by this work: its second parameter is a 32-bit context, not a pointer.
